entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MQ: Audit uses of `ConditionalFact`/`ConditionalTheory` #79615
  • Creating a dynamic assembly with the same name as any assembly in the process causes debugging to fail within that assembly #79612
  • Obsolete values should not be cases required to be listed explicitly in "Populate switch" diagnostic (IDE0010|IDE0072) #79610
  • Excessive CPU and memory usage (70+ GB) when running analyzers #79607
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Remote.ServiceHub unnecessarily targets netstandard2.0 #79598

Closed

  • Extension: foreach in nested method in new extension methods will cause a compiler exception #79212
  • `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer` does not respect dynamic registration for diagnostics #76624
  • "Implement Interface" code generation does not respect editorconfig line endings in some scenarios. #79584
    Backlog
  • CA1822 False positive/conflict with new Extension syntax #78858
